languageOrder: Alternate zh/en and en/zh by task; one query per language and task. No repetition.
budgetRule: Preserve returned order and formatted text, count metadata and line numbers; truncate to a token prefix, then drop an incomplete trailing line. Never select by reference labels.
coverageRule: Any alternative may satisfy a unit; all source lines in that alternative are required. Validate returned line text against the fixed snapshot before credit.
aggregation: Equal weight units within each question; mean of ten question coverages separately for zh and en. English minus Chinese is paired language gap, not a separate sample.
notes: No Agent, answer-generation LLM, query rewriting outside the engine, or downstream code-edit evaluation.
No billed-cost claim without billing data.
Unjudged returned content is not automatically irrelevant. Noise fraction needs separate relevance review.
All ten questions are development tasks; no holdout or general superiority claim.
